reading.title: Mars-Jupiter Conjunction Under Scorpio Sun
overview: The Sun at 25° Scorpio squares Mars and Jupiter at 26° Leo while those two bodies remain in tight conjunction. Mundane tradition reads this as leaders and institutions pressing expansionist moves that risk overreach, with the Scorpio emphasis on hidden resources and shared assets.

Uranus at 4° Gemini retrograde trines Pluto at 3° Aquarius while Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextiles Pluto; these slow contacts point to gradual shifts in collective assumptions and technological or social upheaval. The Moon at 18° Aquarius is not void and next aspects Venus at 23° Libra, suggesting diplomatic or financial channels remain open for the moment.

Saturn at 8° Aries retrograde stays in fall and conjoins Neptune, a configuration traditionally linked to institutional fatigue or unclear boundaries in security matters. The last new moon at 17° Scorpio fell in the third house for the United States and the twelfth for Russia, Ukraine and Israel, framing communications, hidden actors and espionage as active zones.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC within 1° while the Sun trines natal Mercury; tradition associates Neptune on the MC with diffused public authority or unclear leadership signals. Today's reporting on new congressional faces aligns with that Neptune contact, though the fair-test records show no reliable link between such transits and measurable events.

Transiting Uranus opposes natal Jupiter and Jupiter squares natal Venus; these contacts coincide with markets pricing the 2026 local elections. The Uranus-Pluto trine and Neptune-Pluto sextile appear in the same reporting cluster, yet the records indicate these patterns perform no better than chance against election outcomes.

Transiting Pluto conjoins natal Saturn while Jupiter conjoins natal Mercury; the new moon sits in the twelfth house. EU statements on Russian combatant lists sit near the Sun-square-Mars configuration, but the tested Mars-affliction record against Ukrainian alerts shows no improvement over random expectation.

reading.lore_and_intel: Mars-Jupiter conjunction and Sun-square-Mars appear alongside reporting on UUV programs, space reactors and EU entry-ban lists, matching the lore's expansionist and confrontational themes at z-values above 4. Uranus-trine-Pluto and Neptune-sextile-Pluto overlap with Taiwan election markets and Brexit-campaign stories. No such overlap exists with the South African shootings or the unverified Bahrain radar claim, and the fair-test results state that Mars affliction, full moons and eclipses show no predictive edge over chance for the corresponding conflict or seismic indicators.

watch.note: Sun enters Sagittarius; watch for shifts in foreign-policy tone or legislation.
Full Moon at Gemini 2°; monitor public statements and transport or data incidents.
Mars enters Virgo; note any change in operational tempo or procurement detail.
Saturn stations direct; observe whether stalled security or financial files regain momentum.

reading.the_test: The compiled records show Mars affliction versus Ukrainian air-raid alarms performs at -1% above chance (p=0.43). Full moons versus the same alarms reach +6% (p=0.11) and eclipses versus magnitude-6+ quakes reach +1% (p=0.65); after correction none reach statistical significance. New and full moons versus worldwide quakes sit at -5% (p=0.25).
